name: BACH_0321
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and second-model agreement.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 97%, Normal 2%, InSitu 1% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.997 / 76th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Benign | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Strongest lower-invasive association in concept model · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 3, 4) · ↓ invasive · Lower-invasive association [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Lower-invasive association [F4] · Weak
- **Neoplastic nuclei** (regions 0, 4, 8) · context · None detected in three sampled regions · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 region removal drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- One of five similar cases is Normal (BACH_0207); Benign versus Normal is the closest call.
- Cell data cover 3 of 12 regions, with too few tumor nuclei to measure.

## Check on the slide
1. **6** Only region with positive invasive contribution (+0.09); look for tumor.
2. **8** Tumor-infiltrating stroma concept peaks here (validated); confirm stroma is benign.
3. **5** Duct-confined atypia concept peaks here (weak spot check); exclude in situ.
